summary: XCHG Ltd filed a Form 6-K press release announcing the appointment of Albina Iljasov as Co-Chief Executive Officer effective June 1, 2026. She will serve alongside continuing Co-CEO Yifei Hou, overseeing European operations, information security and cybersecurity initiatives. The appointment is part of the board's belief that a Co-CEO structure will strengthen operational execution and international growth. Iljasov previously served as Head of Europe since 2021. The move is a management addition, not a forced departure, so it qualifies as "Management Changes" under this framework. No financial terms, board recommendation, or advisors are mentioned. Watch for any future organizational shifts or strategic pivots under the new co-leadership.
